questions.question: D is the midpoint of side BC of ΔABC. Point E lies on AC such that CE = AC/3. BE and AD intersect at G. What is AG/GD?
questions.solution:
Given:

D is the midpoint of side BC of ΔABC 

CE = AC/3 

BE and AD intersect at G 

Calculations:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a435d4c3e03d2fbafcbfed65ac96e12106cd9e51018427cf41457127871fa434.png] 

Let DP is parallel to BE 

In ΔBCE and ΔDCP 

∠CEB = ∠CPD (The corresponding angles between two parallel lines are equal)

∠CBE = ∠CDP ( The corresponding angles between two parallel lines are equal)

By AA (Rule of similarity), ΔBCE ∼ ΔDCP 

∴ (BC/DC) = (CE/CP) 

⇒ (BD + DC)/DC = (CP + PE)/CP

⇒ BD/DC + 1 = 1 + PE/CP

⇒ 1/1 = PE/CP

⇒ PE = CP = CE/2 

⇒ PE/CE = 1/2

In ΔADP and ΔAGE 

∠ADP = ∠AGE 

∠APD = ∠AEG 

By AA (Rule of similarity),ΔADP ∼ ΔAGE 

∴ (AD/AG) = (AP/AE)

⇒ (AG + GD)/AG = (AE + PE)/AE 

⇒ 1 + GD/AG = 1 + PE/AE 

⇒ GD/AG = PE/AE 

⇒ AG/GD = AE/PE

⇒ AG/GD = AE/(CE/2)

⇒ AG/GD = 2 × AE/CE 

⇒ AG/GD = 2 × 2/1 

⇒ AG/GD = 4 ∶ 1 

∴ AG/GD = 4 ∶ 1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49cc5d498572c7a5117e9b29d4e17b362d2daf9016bcc567015dbb52f9a15421.png] 

Given,

D is the midpoint of side BC

So, BD : DC = 1 : 1

Point E lies on AC such that CE = AC/3

So, AC : CE = 3 : 1

So, CE is 1 and AE = AC - CE

So, AE = 2

AE : CE = 2 : 1

From the following figure balancing sides of the triangle, then

LCM of 2, 1, 1 and 1 is 2

∴ AG : GD = 4 : 1

questions.question: If 16a⁴ + 36a²b² + 81b⁴ = 91 and 4a² + 9b² – 6ab = 13, then what is the value of 3ab?
questions.solution:
16a⁴ + 36a²b² + 81b⁴ = 91

⇒ (4a²)² + 4a² × 9b² + (9b²)² = 91

⇒ Adding 4a² × 9b² to make (a + b)²

⇒ (4a²)² + 2(4a² × 9b²) + (9b²)² = 91 + 4a² × 9b²

⇒ (4a² + 9b²)² = 91 + 36a²b² ----(1)

Now, 4a² + 9b² – 6ab = 13

⇒ 4a² + 9b² = 13 + 6ab ----(2)

Putting equation 2 in equation 1

⇒ (13 + 6ab)² = 91 + 36a²b²

⇒ 169 + 36 a²b² + 156ab = 91 + 36 a²b²

⇒ 156ab = - 78

⇒ ab = - ½

⇒ 3ab = - 3/2

questions.question: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 10 hours and 40 hours respectively. C is an outlet pipe attached to the tank. If all the three pipes are opened simultaneously, it takes 80 minutes more time than A and B together takes to fill the tank. If A and B kept open for 7 hours and closed and then C opened. How much time will C take to empty the tank :
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/854898d0b5ad46c1c95660da0dfeb0d56e036483971cfa4a0956dee96b7474a2.png] 

Total work = 40

Time taken to fill the tank A and B together = 40/(1 + 4) = 8 hrs

Let the efficiency of C be x.

If all three pipe A, B and outlet pipe C open, time taken to fill the tank = 8 hr + 80 min = 9 + 1/3 = 28/3 hrs

Efficiency of A, B and C = 40/(28/3) = 30/7

According to the question

4 + 1 + x = 30/7

⇒ x = 30/7 – 5

⇒ x = (–5/7)

Work done by A and B in 7 hrs = (4 + 1) × 7 = 35

∴ Pipe C empty the tank filled by A and B in 7 hrs = 35/(5/7) = 49 hrs

questions.question: The average of 24 numbers is 56. The average of the first 10 numbers is 71.7 and that of the next 11 number is 42. Then next three numbers (i.e 22ⁿd, 23rd, and 24th) are in the ratio 1/2 : 1/3 : 5/12 What is the average of the 22ⁿd and 24th numbers?
questions.solution:
Average of 24 numbers = 56

Sum of 24 numbers = 56 × 24 = 1344

Average of first 10 numbers = 71.7

Sum of first 10 numbers = 71.7 × 10 = 717

Average of next 11 numbers = 42

Sum of next 11 numbers = 42 × 11 = 462

Sum of 22ⁿd, 23rd and 24th = 1344 – 717 – 462 = 165

Ratio of 22ⁿd, 23rd and 24th = 1/2 : 1/3 : 5/12 = 12/2 : 12/3 : (12 × 5)/12 = 6 : 4 : 5

Ratio of 22ⁿd, 23rd and 24th = 6x : 4x : 5x

6x + 4x + 5x = 165

questions.question: The ratio of the ages of A and B 8 years ago was 2 : 3. Four years ago, the ratio of their ages was 5 : 7. What will be the ratio of their ages 8 years from now?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Multiply 8 years ago ratio (2 : 3) by 2 → 4 : 6 to equalize age difference with 4 years ago ratio (5 : 7).

Change in parts = 5 − 4 = 1 unit, which corresponds to the 4 years passed.

Time gap from 4 years ago to 8 years from now is 12 years ⇒ 12 ÷ 4 = 3 units.

New ratio 8 years from now = (5 + 3) : (7 + 3) = 8 : 10 = 4 : 5.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 : 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
• 
 
 
 
 
 
 -8 Yrs
 -4 Yrs
 Present
 +8 Yrs
 
 
 2 : 3

 
 5 : 7

 
 3 : 4

 
 4 : 5
 
 → 4 : 6
 → 5 : 7
 → 6 : 8
 → 8 : 10

 
• 
 

 4 yrs = 1 unit
 
 
• 
 

 12 yrs = 3 units

**Given:**

Ratio of A's age to B's age 8 years ago = 2 : 3

Ratio of their ages 4 years ago = 5 : 7

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the ages of A and B 8 years ago be 2x and 3x respectively.

⇒ 4 years ago, A's age = 2x + 4 and B's age = 3x + 4

⇒ According to the question, (2x + 4) / (3x + 4) = 5 / 7

⇒ 7 × (2x + 4) = 5 × (3x + 4)

⇒ 14x + 28 = 15x + 20

⇒ 15x − 14x = 28 − 20

⇒ x = 8

⇒ Present age of A = 2x + 8 = 2 × 8 + 8 = 24 years

⇒ Present age of B = 3x + 8 = 3 × 8 + 8 = 32 years

⇒ A's age 8 years from now = 24 + 8 = 32 years

⇒ B's age 8 years from now = 32 + 8 = 40 years

⇒ Required ratio = 32 : 40 = 4 : 5

**∴ The correct answer is 4 : 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Constant Age Difference

The difference between the ages of two individuals always remains constant. Equalizing the horizontal difference between ratio parts simplifies age problems without requiring algebraic equations.

Cross-Multiplication Method

If initial ratio a : b changes to final ratio c : d after adding time periods x and y, you can apply the cross-product rule: (a × d) − (b × c) = (c × y) − (d × x) to solve directly.

Ratio Properties

Multiplying or dividing both terms of a ratio by the same non-zero number does not change its value. A duplicate ratio of a : b is given as a² : b².

Two chords AB and CD of a circle with centre O intersect each other at P. fi ∠ APC = 95° and ∠ AOD = 110°.∠BOC is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∠APC = 95° 

∠AOD = 110° 

**Concept used:**

1.) The angle subtended by an arc of a circle at its anywhere on the circle’s circumference is half of the angle it subtends by the same arc of a circle at a centre. 

2.) An exterior angle of a triangle is equal to the sum of the opposite interior angles.

3.) When two lines intersect each other than the vertically opposite angles are always equal.

4.) Complete angle = 360° 

**Formula used:**

∠APC = (∠AOC + ∠BOD)/2

**Calculations:**

< [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58647baf4d853200067e15196bbc3534cc04196bcfcda1681e9f837cc893e7ed.png] 

∠AOD = 110° and ∠APC = 95° 

Let ∠AOC and ∠BOD be x° and y° respectively 

∠DCB = ∠BOD/2

⇒ y°/2 

∠ABC = ∠AOC/2 

⇒ x°/2 

∠APC is the external angle for ΔPBC 

So, ∠APC = ∠PBC + ∠PCB 

⇒ 95° = x°/2 + y°/2 

⇒ x° + y° = 190° 

∠AOD + ∠AOC + ∠BOC + ∠BOD = 360° (Complete angle)

⇒ 110° + x° + y° + ∠BOC = 360° 

⇒ 110° + 190° + ∠BOC = 360° 

⇒ ∠BOC = 60° 

**∴ The value of ∠BOC is 60° **

questions.question: Sides AB and DC of a cyclic quadrilateral ABCD are produced to meet at E, and sides AD and BC are produced to meet at F. ∠ADC = 75°, and ∠BEC = 52°, then the difference between ∠BAD and ∠AFB is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30e730241b04f176eca28ff147c02f731d47437ab22d3cdf6af47306adeeadb4.png] 

∠ADC = 75° and ∠BEC = 52°

As we know, In a cyclic quadrilateral, the sum of opposite angles are 180°.

∠ADC + ∠ABC = 180°

⇒ ∠ABC = 180° – 75° = 105°

⇒ ∠ABC + ∠CBE = 180° Δ [straight line]

⇒ ∠CBE = 180° – 105° = 75°

In ΔBEC

∠CBE + ∠BEC + ∠ECB = 180°

⇒ ∠ECB = 180° °– 75° – 52° °= 53°

⇒ ∠ECB + ∠BCD = 180° [straight line]

⇒ ∠BCD = 180° – 53° = 127°

⇒ ∠BAD + ∠BCD = 180°

⇒ ∠BAD = 180° – 127° = 53°

In ΔAFB

∠BAF + ∠ABF + ∠AFB = 180°

⇒ ∠AFB = 180° – 53° – 105° = 22°

∴ Difference between ∠BAD and ∠AFB = 53° – 22° = 31°

questions.question: In an examination in which the full marks were 500, A scored 25% more marks than B, B scored 60% more marks than C and C scored 20% less marks than D. If A scored 80% marks, then the percentage of marks obtained by D is:
questions.solution:
Maximum marks of the examination = 500

A scored = 500 × (80/100) = 400

B scored = 400 × (100/125) = 320

C scored = 320 × (100/160) = 200

D scored = 200 × (100/80) = 250

Percentage of D = 250/500 × 100 = 50%

**Other method:**

Ratio of A to B = 5 : 4

Ratio of B to C = 8 : 5

Ratio of C to D = 4 : 5

Taking only ratio A to D = 160 : 100

Divide by 2 only, then A : D = 80 : 50

If A got 80%, then D got 50%

questions.question: A train takes 2(1)/(2)hours less for a journey of 300 km, if its speed is increased by 20 km/h from its usual speed. How much time will it take to cover a distance of 192 km at its usual speed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A train takes 2(1)/(2)hours less for a journey of 300 km, if its speed is increased by 20 km/h from its usual speed.

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

**Calculation:**

2(1)/(2) = (5)/(2)

Let speed of train be x km/hr

According to the question

[300/x] – [300/(x + 20)] = 5/2

⇒ 300 [x + 20 – x]/[x (x + 20) = 5/2

⇒ 6000/(x² + 20x) = 5/2

⇒ 12000 = 5x² + 100x

⇒ x² + 20x – 2400 = 0

⇒ x² + 60x – 40x – 2400 = 0

⇒ x (x + 60) – 40 (x + 60) = 0

⇒ (x + 60) (x – 40) = 0

Taking,

⇒ (x – 40) = 0

⇒ x = 40 km/hr

Speed of the train = 40 km/hr

**∴ Time taken to cover 192 km by train = 192/40 = 4.8 hrs**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** Let the usual speed = x

Increased speed is (x + 20)

[300/x] – [300/(x + 20)] = 5/2

Using different values x = 40, - 60

As speed is 40.

Time taken to cover 192/40 = 4.8hrs

questions.question: The compound interest on a certain sum at 16(2)/(3)% p. a for 3 years is Rs. 6,350 What will be the simple interest on the same at the same rate for 5(2)/(3) years?

CI = P [(1 + r/100)³ – 1]

⇒ 6350 = P [(1 + 1/6)³ – 1]

⇒ 6350 = P [(7/6)³ – 1]

⇒ 6350 = P [343/216 – 1]

⇒ P = 6350 × (216/127)

⇒ P = 10800

Now,

P = 10800, r = 16(2)/(3)\% = frac{{50}}{3}\% and T = 5(2)/(3) = frac{{17}}{3}year

SI = 10200

⇒ 343 – 216 = 127

⇒ 127 unit = 6350

Now,
